inventory_domain_decision.reason: A dedicated domain owner is acceptable for inventory aggregate/value invariants that are not already owned by item.py, services, ports, repositories or UoW.
forbidden_responsibilities: Item definition already owned by item.py
equipment compatibility already owned by equipment.py
Unit of Work and transaction management
pagination, sorting, localized labels or Telegram callbacks
duplicate functions or constants already defined in another production module
inventory_domain_decision.creation_gate: Before writing each public symbol, scan rom_v2 for the same name and semantic responsibility; if an owner exists, import/reuse it instead of redefining it.

rules: one semantic responsibility has one authoritative owner
no duplicate public function/class/constant names in production scope
reuse existing item and equipment policies instead of copying
inventory_id is the stable item-instance identity
validate ownership, level, class, slot and two-handed/off-hand conflicts before side effects
equip/unequip is atomic within one UoW
query sorting/pagination/details/compare remain pure and do not mutate
no Telegram or localized presentation work until 21.18.1b
migration allowed only when a concrete schema gap is proven by integration tests
required_tests: class and required-level rejection without mutation
two-handed main-hand clears or rejects off-hand according to canonical equipment policy
off-hand rejects conflict with equipped two-handed main-hand
transaction rollback restores inventory and equipment slots
